integrity: Proof and two exact arithmetic enumerations are included. The assertion of novelty is a checked best-knowledge comparison, not an independence or peer-review claim.
scientific_limitations: The exact chamber enumeration applies to the complex blow-up of six distinct points arranged as two disjoint collinear triples. It neither classifies every root system nor determines chamber volumes. Historical priority of the numeric support polynomial remains provisional.
title: Zariski-chamber support polynomial of a two-triple-line cubic resolution
